issues.where: upper-left and upper-center globe near terminator (crops B, F, G in image-06.png and crops J, K, L in image-07.png)
issues.what: severe polar UV stretching smears craters and surface texture into long diagonal streaks
issues.fix: remap the globe with cube-sphere or triplanar projection, or rotate the pole out of the close-up view and supply dedicated polar detail maps

issues.where: entire close-up globe surface and terminator (crops A, C, E, F, G, H, I in image-06.png; L, P, Q, R in image-07.png; V in image-08.png)
issues.what: albedo and normal maps are far too low-resolution for this camera distance, creating soft, mushy surface detail on the lit side and a plastic, waxy embossed look on shadow-side crater rims
issues.fix: use higher-resolution tiled albedo and displacement maps and add procedural micro-crater detail for close-up framing

issues.where: lower-left night side of the globe extending to the left limb (crop D in image-02.png and crop P in image-03.png)
issues.what: a stray semi-transparent ghosted object resembling a spacecraft boom with rectangular boxes appears across the dark hemisphere
issues.fix: remove the contaminated flare or background plate artifact and ensure the unlit hemisphere cleanly occludes layers behind it

issues.where: lower-left sky outside the dark limb (crop D in image-02.png, crop O in image-03.png, and crop T in image-04.png)
issues.what: a large blurry oval blob with rainbow chromatic ghosting sits in the starfield alongside smeared flare patches
issues.fix: remove baked lens-ghost blobs from the sky plate so background stars remain clean point sources

issues.where: sunlit upper and right limb of the globe (crop F in image-02.png and crops K, L, Q in image-03.png)
issues.what: an artificial warm orange atmospheric rim halo wraps around an airless cratered world like a 2D outer-glow effect
issues.fix: remove the atmospheric halo layer on this airless body and restrict limb brightness to physical surface backscatter and subtle optical bloom

issues.where: sunlit right limb silhouette (crops E, I in image-06.png and crop R in image-07.png)
issues.what: a hard, slightly faceted geometric limb edge sits directly against blurry interior surface texture with a thin bright rim line
issues.fix: increase sphere tessellation with fine silhouette displacement and match surface texture sharpness up to the limb

issues.where: solar corona and photosphere (crop C in image-02.png, crops M, N, R in image-03.png, and crop C in image-06.png)
issues.what: pinpoint background stars shine directly through bright solar corona streamers while the solar surface texture in crops M and N is soft and blobby
issues.fix: mask or wash out faint background stars inside intense coronal glare and increase solar photosphere detail before bloom

issues.where: lower unlit globe interior (crops T and U in image-08.png)
issues.what: subtle gradient banding is visible across the dark night-side hemisphere
issues.fix: composite in 16-bit or 32-bit float and apply dithering when exporting to 8-bit PNG

issues.where: upper lit hemisphere, toward the sun
issues.what: craters are dragged into parallel diagonal streaks instead of round bowls
issues.fix: replace the high-latitude mapping so the upper disk keeps round craters

issues.where: crops B, F, and H, and the lit sliver in I
issues.what: at native size the same streaks wipe out crater rims across the upper disk
issues.fix: recheck these crops at 1:1 after the mapping change; rims should be closed curves

issues.what: the stretch continues along the top of the disk and smears the bright rays in front of the sun
issues.fix: keep those rays radial and the craters round, not pulled along the mapping

issues.where: crop B, lower right rayed craters
issues.what: the bright ejecta reads as a flat white splash laid on the ground
issues.fix: shade the rays with the terrain so they break on slopes and in shadow

issues.where: crops T and U, nearest ground
issues.what: the foreground regolith is soft and the fine grain does not hold up
issues.fix: raise near-ground texture resolution so the closest soil stays sharp
